notes: The playlist pills stop one at a time now instead of drifting to a halt between two of them, so the name you were aiming for is the one you get.
Each pill is a little taller and wider, which makes the strip easier to hit and to read as it moves.
The rail on the right can be arranged: hold a glyph until it lifts, drag it past its neighbours, and the order you leave it in is the order it comes back in.
